meta.title: Phone2Laptop — Transfer files between phone and computer
meta.description: Freely transfer your photos, PDFs, videos, links and notes between your phone and computer. No app, no account and no cable.

hero.title: Move your files from phone to computer in seconds.
hero.subtitle: iPhone, Android, Windows or Mac: any combination works. One scan is all it takes to send photos, PDFs, videos, links or notes — no app, no cable.
hero.reassurance1: Works with iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac · No account · Nothing to install
hero.reassurance2: End-to-end encrypted · Automatically deleted after 30 minutes · 50 MB max per file

transfer.qrAria: QR code to connect your phone
transfer.instruction: Scan with your phone to connect both devices.
transfer.expiryPending: the deletion timer will start with the first file
transfer.drop: You can also drag and drop (max. 50 MB/file)

how.title: One scan is all it takes.
how.step1Text: Open on your computer, it is unique to your session.
how.step3Text: A file, photo, document, link or note — in whichever direction you need.
how.desktopStep1: Scan this QR code with your phone.
how.desktopStep2: Pick a file or type a note.
how.mobileInstruction: Open phone2laptop.com on your computer, then scan the QR code shown there.

usage.title: For everyday small transfers
usage.card1Text: Get a photo taken on your phone onto your computer in seconds.
usage.card2Text: Send a document to your phone to read, sign or share it.
usage.card3Text: Copy a link or a piece of text between your devices without messaging apps.
usage.card4Text: Android and Mac, iPhone and Windows, or any combination with a modern browser.

comparison.title: More direct than email, cloud storage or a cable
comparison.intro: You shouldn't have to email yourself, hunt for a cable, or drop a file in the cloud to move it between two devices sitting right in front of you.
comparison.note: * The provider hosts the transferred files and, under its own terms of service, may have access to their content.

security.title: Your transfers stay private
security.intro: Designed to limit data collection and reduce how long transferred content is kept.
security.block1Text: No account is required to use the service. Phone2Laptop does not create a personal profile linked to your transfers.
security.block2Text: Your files and notes are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) on your device before being sent.
security.block2Detail: The keys needed to decrypt them stay only on the devices in your session — never on our servers.
security.block3Text: The countdown starts as soon as the first file is sent, and extends by 30 minutes with every new file. If no file is sent, you can delete your session manually at any time.
security.block4Text: The project is open source: the code handling encryption and file deletion is public and reviewable.

solenis.title: An MVP built to get straight to the point
solenis.text: Phone2Laptop was designed and built by Solenis Studio, which helps founders and companies design and build their SaaS, business apps and digital products.

support.title: Finding Phone2Laptop useful?
support.text: The service is free and ad-free. Your support helps fund its hosting and maintenance.

footer.tagline: The private shortcut between your phone and your computer.
